title: Butterfly-shaped, heterometallic, hexanuclear, [Fe2IIILn4III] (LnIII = GdIII, TbIII, DyIII and HoIII) Complexes: Syntheses, structure and magnetism

synthesis.procedure: General aerobic procedure for 1–4: L'H3 (0.05 g, 0.18 mmol) was dissolved in methanol (20 mL). Ln(NO3)3·nH2O (0.18 mmol) and triethylamine (0.1 mL, 0.7 mmol) were added and the mixture was stirred for 30 min at room temperature. Fe(ClO4)2·6H2O (0.05 g, 0.18 mmol) and pivalic acid (0.07 g, 0.72 mmol) were then added and stirring continued for 6 h at room temperature. The clear reddish-brown solution was filtered and kept for crystallization. After one week, block-shaped red crystals suitable for X-ray crystallography were obtained. For 1, Ln = Gd.

properties.summary: dc susceptibility (2–300 K, 0.1 T) shows a steady χT decrease consistent with dominant antiferromagnetic interactions. χT(300 K) = 41.32 cm3 K mol−1 vs 40.25 calculated for six non-interacting ions. Magnetization at 2 K and 7 T is 29.2 μB, approaching saturation consistent with four parallel GdIII spins and two essentially antiparallel FeIII spins. No hysteresis above 1.8 K; zero-dc-field ac susceptibility shows no out-of-phase signal (no SMM slow relaxation).

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same general aerobic procedure as 1–4, using Tb(NO3)3·nH2O (0.18 mmol) as the lanthanide source. L'H3 (0.05 g, 0.18 mmol) in methanol (20 mL) with Ln salt and NEt3 (0.1 mL, 0.7 mmol) was stirred 30 min, then Fe(ClO4)2·6H2O (0.05 g, 0.18 mmol) and pivalic acid (0.07 g, 0.72 mmol) were added and stirred 6 h at room temperature. Filtration and standing afforded block-shaped red crystals after one week.

properties.summary: χT decreases from 300 to 2 K, indicating dominant antiferromagnetic interactions plus thermal depopulation of TbIII excited states. χT(300 K) = 52.20 cm3 K mol−1 vs 56.03 calculated. Magnetization 19.5 μB at 2 K/7 T without saturation; non-superimposed M vs H/T plots indicate magnetic anisotropy. No hysteresis above 1.8 K and no out-of-phase ac signal (no SMM behavior).

properties.summary: χT decreases from 300 to 2 K (antiferromagnetic interactions plus DyIII depopulation). χT(300 K) = 62.36 cm3 K mol−1 vs 65.43 calculated. Magnetization 24.0 μB at 2 K/7 T without saturation; M vs H/T non-superposition indicates anisotropy. No hysteresis above 1.8 K and no out-of-phase ac signal. 57Fe Mössbauer at 3 K is a quadrupole doublet (ΔEQ = −1.07 mm/s, δ = 0.38 mm/s); applied 4 T field produces hyperfine splitting equal only to the external field, confirming a non-magnetic S = 0 Fe2 ground state and no Dy-to-Fe transfer field.
